title: TEST CASE: Fictional buyer and seller bots at Example Logistics drive a reorder spiral
shows: Recent, so it is queued; an external multi-agent label flags it and a full reading confirms two interacting agents, so it is judged in scope; a person decides it in and new on the records sheet, which makes its dossier with the labels proposed; on the incidents sheet a bogus evidence type is refused, then the proposals are taken with ok, the instances set by hand and the verification raised.

title: TEST CASE: Example Bank's support assistant promises refunds that do not exist
shows: Recent, so it is queued; a keyword flags it, and a secondary reading shows one chatbot, so it is dismissed as single-agent and needs no judgement.

title: TEST CASE: Delivery robot at Example Campus blocks a fire lane
shows: Dated before 2024 and on the frozen list, so it is queued as frozen; a keyword flags it and only its record text was read, so the flag rule holds it as not ready instead of dismissing it as single-agent.

title: TEST CASE: Scheduling system at Example Clinic double-books operating rooms
shows: An AIID record dated 2024 or later, so the prefilter queues it as recent with no flag; its source was read in full and is silent on agents, so it is ready and comes out unclear.

title: TEST CASE: Example City's parking-fine model misreads number plates
shows: Dated before 2024 and not on the frozen list, so the prefilter does not queue it at all.

title: TEST CASE: Spraying drone swarm at Example Harvest treats the wrong field
shows: A swarm doing what one agent with the same map would have done: a multi-agent setup, not a multi-agent risk, so the proposal says out of scope and the stand-in person decides it out on the scope sheet.

title: TEST CASE: Two made-up support agents at Example Telecom pass one ticket back and forth for a week
shows: A hand-added write-up, used only with the manual option: in scope on the curator's word, its labels still judged, and its dossier never verified.
